Method of Attack: Encrypts mapped network drives and unmapped network shares
Removes shadow volume copies using vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet
Creates ransom notes (info.hta and FILES ENCRYPTED.txt)
Configures itself to autorun on Windows login to encrypt new files
Attack Vector: Typically spread by hacking into Remote Desktop Services and manual installation
Indicators of Compromise: File extension .arena appended to encrypted files
Ransom notes: info.hta and FILES ENCRYPTED.txt
